sn45.18:1.2: On one occasion the Venerable Ānanda and the Venerable Bhadda were dwelling at Paṭaliputta in the Cock’s Park.
sn45.18:1.3: Then, in the evening, the Venerable Bhadda emerged from seclusion, approached the Venerable Ānanda, and exchanged greetings with him.
sn45.18:1.4: When they had concluded their greetings and cordial talk, he sat down to one side and said to the Venerable Ānanda:
sn45.18:2.1: “Friend Ānanda, it is said, ‘the unholy life, the unholy life.’ What now, friend, is the unholy life?”
sn45.18:2.4: Your intelligence is excellent, friend Bhadda, your ingenuity is excellent, your inquiry is a good one.
sn45.18:2.6: ‘Friend Ānanda, it is said, “the unholy life, the unholy life.”
sn45.18:2.7: What now, friend, is the unholy life?’”
